policy: Run Core after changes. Memory and Placement require an explicit user request; never infer authorization from a build or Core request.

Core.scope: Fast production calculations, formatting, settings and normal-value UI correctness. No memory probes or deliberate insufficient-area cases.

Memory.scope: Isolated font probes, native-callback observation, layout/resource matrix and switching memory validation. Explicit request only.

Placement.scope: Deliberately insufficient areas, overflowing values, full-grid fallback and compact-message behavior. Explicit request only.
